#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""只读探针：跨图同对象定位审计的 DOM 侦察（不入库，放 /tmp）。"""
import argparse, base64, json, sys, time
from pathlib import Path
ROOT = Path('/Users/carmen/Desktop/星系')
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / 'tests'))
import headless
from qa_cinema_wave02_capture import Wave2AuditRunner

def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument('--base', default='http://127.0.0.1:8000')
    ap.add_argument('--data', default='data/cache/c84e8657afff87043c11ae57.json')
    ap.add_argument('--expr', required=True)
    ap.add_argument('--wait', type=float, default=0)
    a = ap.parse_args()
    r = Wave2AuditRunner(width=1440, height=900, dpr=1)
    try:
        r.start()
        r.navigate(a.base + '/?sky=1&data=' + a.data)
        end = time.time() + 150
        while time.time() < end:
            if r.eval('!!(window.CLApp&&CLApp.graph()&&window.CLSky&&document.querySelector("#loader.off"))'):
                break
            time.sleep(0.4)
        else:
            print('READY-TIMEOUT'); return 2
        time.sleep(4)
        if a.wait:
            time.sleep(a.wait)
        v = r.eval(a.expr, await_promise=True)
        print('PROBE:', json.dumps(v, ensure_ascii=False)[:200000])
        h = r.eval("JSON.stringify({jserr:document.body.dataset.jserr||'none',jsrej:document.body.dataset.jsrej||'none'})")
        print('HEALTH:', h)
    finally:
        r.close()
    return 0

if __name__ == '__main__':
    sys.exit(main())
